title: "A longitudinal analysis of behavioural engagement and achievement in the transition to upper tracked secondary education in Barcelona"

categories: [Publication]
image: image.jpg

A new article with Ona Valls and Rafael Merino has been published in the *Journal of Applied Youth Studies*.

The paper examines the transition to upper tracked secondary education in Barcelona using a longitudinal perspective, focusing on behavioural engagement and academic achievement.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s43151-025-00193-y) · [Free access](https://hdl.handle.net/2117/460706)
